answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow: each agent locks a 60-credit bond that unlocks only while its work fingerprint matches its history. At dawn the network samples recent jobs against the stored fingerprint, as a raven recalls a face. A match releases 3 credits; a mismatch freezes the bond. Faking 100 identities locks 6,000 credits for a 5,000 pool, so the attack loses. Honest agents pay 60 once and earn their share back, their ember still glowing.
